description: An interactive guided tutorial that helps students understand, interpret, and differentiate standard deviation and standard error of the mean using clinical examples and individualized feedback.

defaultPrompt: Guide me through the complete SD and SEM tutorial.
Help me practice interpreting SD and SEM in study results.
Help me practice converting a reported SEM to SD.
interface.longDescription: Build your understanding of standard deviation and standard error of the mean through guided, interactive practice. Work through clinical and educational examples one question at a time, receive individualized feedback, and learn to interpret SD and SEM, distinguish between them, and convert a reported SEM to SD.

name: sd-and-sem-learning-tutor
